{{Quote|Well, good, good, good. Look around, browse around, make yourself at home... As you can see I've got just about everything a man or wookiee would want.|Saun Dann|<ref name="SWHS" />}}
Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the '''Trading post Wookiee Planet C''', run by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Saun Dann]], was established on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]&mdash;known as "Wookiee Planet C" by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;in the vicinity of the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]. In this shop, Dann sold many kinds of items, from pocket-sized aquariums with live [[Fish/Legends|fishes]] to high-tech groomers and [[Mind evaporator/Legends|mind evaporators]]. The trading post was also equipped with a monitor allowing Dann to communicate with a wall screen customers.<ref name="SWHS" />

The trading post's owner Saun Dann was secretly loyal to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but he did not mind doing business with Imperials.<ref name="SWHS" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Trading_post_on_computer-SWHS.png|thumb|The trading post designation appears on Mallatobuck's computer screen.]]
The trading post Wookiee Planet C was featured in [[The Star Wars Holiday Special|''Star Wars Holiday Special'']], a TV movie released on [[March 17]] [[1978]]. The trading post's full designation was never spoken on-screen, but appeared on [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck's]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] when the Wookiee tried to contact Saun Dann.<ref name="SWHS" />
